description: The bar chart illustrates the execution accuracy of NatSQL and TA-SQL across different categories, including Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, while the vertical axis represents Execution Accuracy, ranging from 20 to 60 in increments of 10. The chart features grouped bars, with each category containing two bars: a light blue bar representing NatSQL and a dark blue bar representing TA-SQL. The values for NatSQL are approximately 60.21, 39.64, 32.32, and 51.35 for Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total, respectively, while the corresponding values for TA-SQL are approximately 63.14, 48.60, 36.11, and 56.19. The bars are grouped by category, with NatSQL and TA-SQL values displayed side by side, allowing for a direct comparison between the two. The chart does not display any specific sorting order among the categories, and no bars are visually emphasized.
